answer: A velvet rope looks like security, but scripts walk through. Completion-gated payout works: no payout until one finishes 40 tasks for 40 different verified buyers. Each buyer costs ten dollars in identity checks and needs its own card. Payout needs the buyer's signed receipt, so self-dealing burns real fees. Duplicate cards and fingerprints are cross-checked, killing card farms. Raising 100 fakes means crossing a canyon on foot: 40,000 dollars, 100 cards, 800 hours of served work. The comet-bright attacker burns cash per fake identity and never cashes out.
